## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 27.01.2026 - 14.07.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer melden Zuverlässigkeitsprobleme. Das zeigt Qualitätslücken, die Wettbewerber nutzen können.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _QuizoidZ_, 14.07.2026, 1/5: "I love the layout, style, and customization. I prefer a “checklist” style which you can set by putting every goal at a 1/1, but it is interesting this kind of goal, things you do once a day, isn’t innate in the system. Also, the app keeps asking me to rate it… almost daily. Once is enough. 🤣 -1 ⭐️ This is a pretty cool app, but there’s some glitch where even after putting in my 5-star review it keeps asking for them. -1 ⭐️🤣🤣 -1 ⭐️ This is like every day 🤣🤣🤣 -1 ⭐️Now I’m down to one star. Maybe they’ll notice and turn off the constant review nagging. 🤣"
            2. _Skullcandy28_, 09.03.2026, 1/5: "Can’t delete a habit without the App having a hissy fit and freezing. Setting the goals is just too much brain work. I just want to add when I do one habit on the days on the week but can’t figure it out. It’ll show as 1.43 for surfing once in a week. Why not just fulfil the whole habit on that day. What do I have to put in in the habit settings? It’s causing more hassle than habits 😂 Will request a refund from Apple and delete it"
            3. _J_dster_, 12.02.2026, 1/5: "After a recent update last year, App constantly freezes and doesn’t open at all. Had to delete sadly and use another more functioning app. No update has fixed this since"

## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Preis und Paywall.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 18.02.2026 - 11.07.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Aybek.A_, 18.02.2026, 1/5: "Putting creating habits behind a paywall for a habit creating app is not how you charge for a service"
            2. _A Sprz_, 11.07.2026, 3/5: "The app is beautiful. Love the customization. I got a lifetime subscription and am happy to not have to pay annually. Could you please consider adding the ability to increase the font size? It would be perfect then."
            3. _Hermione: Daughter of God_, 01.07.2026, 5/5: "So far, so good. I’ve never bright a premium on an app, but this one I just might because it’s not overpriced and seems to have a great layout and system."
